correctness.rationale: The all-(n,r) formula follows from uniform Dirichlet(1,...,1) spacings, exact degree-two/three factorial moments of gaps and the pairwise squared-distance identity for unbiased sample variance. The finite sums over pairs yield the quadratic 6r(n-r)-n(n-1); denominator is positive for n>=2. Setting m=abs(n-2r) converts zero covariance exactly into (n+1)^2-3m^2=1, whose complete positive solutions are powers (2+sqrt(3))^k with k>=2. Independent Fraction calculations expanded all Dirichlet monomials separately and confirmed every r for n=2..9, including both boundary gaps. These finite checks supplement the analytic all-size moments and Pell descent; zero covariance is not independence.
residual_risks: Finite numerical calculations cannot replace exact infinite proof; conclusions rest on the reconstructed analytic argument and inspected source certificate.

originality.rationale: Kochar 1999 compares the spacing vectors and sample variances of samples from different parent distributions in stochastic order; Royen 2007/2008 determines sample-variance marginal distributions; Yao et al. 2008 treats multivariate total positivity and dependence among spacings. None of the materially inspected text states within-sample rankwise Cov(G_r,S^2) or the Pell zero classification. An exact harmonic covariance with exponential sample range in Resultary concerns a different parent and statistic.
